note: Switzerland applies Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 as a development of the Schengen acquis it is associated with, so a visitor's entry is the EU's common visa list (the eu1806 list).

sources.title: Publications Office of the EU, Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 (as adopted), recitals
sources.said: As regards Switzerland, this Regulation constitutes a development of the provisions of the Schengen acquis
